item.title: Version 2.3.1
item.description:
Improved

  • Apps show their real names and icons. Placeholders like “App 6767…” now resolve — and stay resolved between launches — instead of sticking for the session. An app stuck on a placeholder could never match its RevenueCat project automatically.
  • Other workspaces keep their apps in view. They no longer collapse to a bare row on switch, and clicking one goes straight to that app’s campaigns instead of the full list.
  • The map opens on your whole account, with zoom controls on the map.
  • Money figures are easier to read on dark backgrounds, and now meet contrast guidelines in light mode.
  • The exchange-rate badge only appears when rates are stale, rather than permanently confirming they’re fine.

Fixed

  • Keyword ROAS no longer credits one arbitrary keyword. The same keyword text running in several campaigns had its revenue given to one keyword at random, measured against only that keyword’s spend — inflating one and zeroing its twins. Revenue is now measured against the spend of every keyword using that text.
  • Campaigns deleted in Apple Ads disappear. Emptying a campaign group left every campaign on screen marked Running, with no way to clear them.
  • One workspace’s apps no longer appear in another’s when connecting RevenueCat.
  • A rejected sign-in is no longer reported as connected. Credentials are checked before they’re saved, so a damaged key — often from copying it out of a screenshot — is caught immediately.
  • The sidebar scrolls to the end again when group labels are hidden.
  • Automatic project matching no longer picks at random when an app appears in two RevenueCat projects.
